notes.title: Ruzar - The Dark Stones: Thanks and Update 1.54.5.51
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I want to take a moment to sincerely thank all of you who have supported the development of Ruzar - The Dark Stones, especially those who took the time to test the game, report bugs, and share their feedback. Thanks to your valuable help, the game is in much better shape today.

I’m happy to announce that I’ve added a group of people to the game’s credits in the "Special Thanks" section for their support. Here’s the list of players who significantly contributed to improving Ruzar - The Dark Stones:

[list]
[*] Dégay Péter
[*] Seven
[*] Robilar5500 
[*] Matej Stepanek
[*] Wizard Worm (Roman Mykhailov)
[*] Klaus, Curator at Adult World Gamers
[/list]

Once again, thank you all for your involvement. Your feedback has made the game more enjoyable for everyone.

As for the current update, here’s the list of fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed map icons displaying incorrect information for some walls and doors in the mines.
[*] Fixed creature pathing in one of the mine areas.
[*] Fixed tiles in the forest that displayed incorrect information on the map.
[*] Fixed graphical artefacts in one of the hideouts.
[*] Fixed an issue that could potentially prevent unlocking a specific hideout's network.
[*] Fixed an issue where dropping a character at a village/campfire wouldn't remove the spell effect icons.
[*] The Cemetery will now correctly trigger "Ednor's Quest"
[*] The quest for Ednor's Blade will now auto-complete when grabbing the quest item.
[*] The quest "Alchemist Villager Meets Elizmere" is now translated in all languages.
[*] The active quest entry will no longer trigger if the level is unloaded.
[*] Some quests now have the correct icons and descriptions.
[*] Fixed the "Treasure Hunter" quest that couln't be completed.
[*] Fixed a secret that was inaccessible in one of the Cemetery Crypts.
[*] Added a hint to the Swamp puzzle.
[*] Fixed an issue where the brazier would not light up when using a torch in one of the Cemetery Crypts.
[*] Fixed the keyhole position for a quest in the Catacombs.
[*] Fixed an issue where the NPCs could not spawn at the campfire.
[*] Fixed corrupted assets due to hard drive failures.
[/list]

Thank you again for your continued support!
